notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

A bunch of cutscenes have been added to the game, intro + victory cutscene for each location, as well as some bonus ones! We also fixed some minor bugs.

Now you can watch any cutscene through the main menu!


 Help Emperor Vladimir Defend Saint Petersburg from the Lizards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/02a426241889e962032e7aec2213fca6b72af420.png
 The United Lizard Flotillas of Nibiru and Mars have attacked Earth! Go on a journey and destroy the lizard bases!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/f8a25b24e07620286d40829d048e0aec10c047bb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/94e4f4af6e7a5761beac62092cef5abd54c33dec.png
 Celebrate the New Year 2024 with Emperor Vladimir, God Perun and the knights - Billyslav Herringtonov and Ivan Darkholmov
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/c483ecae1effbfbee64c2ee700eab6b4927016e6.png
 Go to Sauna with the Great Russian Knights ♂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/dff632b809b7f1514c4e5358c92ffca5b114ba26.png

And more other cutscenes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/8abb4194e6169b0319cca21941dc0b5178580ca1.png

Play and if you like it, please tell all your friends if you haven't already! And also we remind you that the game has a 40% discount, give your friends a great gift for the new year! Thanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/6b3b22420da5fa4a662a23293582cd22cf51cdd4.png

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hi, friends!

In this update:

 Added Sword - Have a Baikal Massacre! (on the left mouse button, Q or Caps Lock - as you prefer)
 Fixed some bugs
 Guide in the main game menu
 Full English voice acting
 Giveaway of Steam Gift Cards and 1000 keys (more details about giveaway you can find at the beginning of the game)


Also we preparing an update with cutscenes for all locations
